mcpServers.prerequisites: Power Platform administrator role; Managed Environment required to govern via Advanced connector policies. Copilot Studio client is on by default; other clients must be enabled.
steps: Power Platform admin center → Manage → Environments → select the environment → Settings.
Settings → Product → Features → Dataverse Model Context Protocol → turn on “Allow MCP clients to interact with Dataverse MCP server”.
For non-default clients (VS Code GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, Claude): Advanced Settings → open the client record → set Is Enabled = Yes → Save & Close.
Connect your client to the server URL https://{org}.crm.dynamics.com/api/mcp.

mcpServers.prerequisites: .NET SDK 10.0+; a coding agent that supports MCP; an existing saved canvas app with Coauthoring enabled (Power Apps Studio → Settings → Updates → Coauthoring).

install.note: Requires /plugin marketplace add microsoft/power-platform-skills first.

steps: Install the plugin: /plugin marketplace add microsoft/power-platform-skills then /plugin install canvas-apps@power-platform-skills (VS Code: Extensions → @agentPlugins canvas apps → Canvas Apps by Microsoft).
Open the canvas app in Power Apps Studio with Coauthoring on; keep the browser tab open; copy the Studio URL.
Run /configure-canvas-mcp, paste the Studio URL, sign in — it auto-extracts environment, app and cluster IDs.
Verify: ask the agent “List the available Canvas App controls.”

mcpServers.prerequisites: Node.js 18+ and Azure CLI (az login). Runs offline — no npm install, no npx, no remote host; ships a self-contained MCP engine (server/mcp.mjs).

install.note: Registered in .mcp.json as 'flowagent'; needs only Node.js 18+ and az login.

steps: Install the plugin (GitHub Copilot CLI or Claude Code): /plugin marketplace add microsoft/power-platform-skills then /plugin install power-automate@power-platform-skills.
Authenticate with Azure CLI: az login (MSAL is used for connection endpoints).
Run the setup skill for first-time prerequisite setup.
Use the skills: browse-flows, create-flow / build-flow, debug-flow / diagnose-flow, manage-flows, manage-desktop-flows.
